issues.description: changedFiles path comparison may fail due to absolute-vs-relative and slash mismatches
issues.detail: isIncluded() compares slash(cleanUrl(_filename)) against this.changedFiles via Array.includes. VitestGit.findChangedFiles typically returns absolute, OS-native paths, while _filename in coverage contexts can be absolute, relative, or URL-form. Without normalization on both sides (resolve + slash) the equality check silently excludes everything. State the invariant: 'both sides are absolute POSIX paths' and enforce it.

issues.description: Array.includes makes isIncluded O(N*M); use a Set
issues.detail: isIncluded() runs once per candidate file; with K candidates and M changed files the membership test is O(K*M). For monorepos K and M are both non-trivial. The right data structure is Set<string>, giving O(K). This is a textbook 'wrong data structure' case — algorithm is fine, the container is paying interest on every call.

issues.description: globCache poisoned by changedFiles makes cache semantics order-dependent
issues.detail: isIncluded() writes the changed-files-filtered result into globCache, which is also consulted before the changedFiles check. onTestRunStart clears the cache when changedFiles is set, but any future caller that mutates changedFiles or invokes isIncluded before onTestRunStart will get stale answers. Invariant 'globCache reflects glob-only inclusion' is silently violated; either key the cache by (filename, changedSnapshot) or cache only the glob result.

issues.description: CLI transform for coverage.changed is under-specified and silently coerces
issues.detail: The transform accepts 'true'/'yes'/true and 'false'/'no'/false but passes everything else through unchanged, including empty string, numbers, or 'TRUE'. State the invariant explicitly: input is a git ref string OR a boolean literal; reject other shapes or document the passthrough. As written, a reader cannot tell whether '--coverage.changed=' is a bug or a feature.

issues.description: onTestRunStart is invoked in three places without a stated invariant
issues.detail: core.ts now calls coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() in three branches. There is no comment stating the invariant 'called exactly once per test run, before any file is loaded'. A future fourth code path will likely forget the call. Centralize the hook or write a one-line literate comment at the declaration site documenting the contract and the call sites.

issues.description: git-shell-out happens unconditionally on every test run when option set
issues.detail: onTestRunStart spawns git for findChangedFiles on every run, even in watch mode where the diff rarely changes between reruns. Not premature to flag: the cost is a real subprocess per rerun. Measure under watch load before optimizing, but consider memoizing by (changedSince, repo HEAD) so the watch loop doesn't re-shell git on every keystroke-triggered rerun.

review.summary: The feature is sensibly scoped and the test coverage is good, but the implementation rests on a few unstated invariants worth auditing before merge. The most load-bearing issue is path normalization: isIncluded compares slashed-and-cleaned filenames against whatever VitestGit returns, with no stated guarantee they share a form. The container choice (Array.includes for membership) is the wrong data structure on a hot path. The globCache is now order-dependent on onTestRunStart having run; that contract should be stated, not implied. Verdict: UNDER-AUDITED, with one WRONG-DATA-STRUCTURE and one NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT alongside.
